subject: SemRisk formal implementation
finding: W2 concepts/relations are not yet final OWL/SHACL/formal artifacts.
claim_consequence: No claim of implemented formal ontology or formal correctness until W3/E1-E4.

subject: SemRisk empirical/expert evaluation
finding: No independent expert validation or release-bound CQ execution yet.

subject: NIST clause/schema completeness
finding: Current semantic baseline is strong, but exact field-level JSON/XLSX/clause mining is incomplete.
claim_consequence: Crosswalk can be conceptually used, but not described as clause/schema complete.

subject: ISO/COSO/OCEG full text/clause access
finding: Public authoritative metadata/available guidance does not equal full source-complete clause extraction.
claim_consequence: Use terminology/process alignment only; mark unknown/not_reported cells explicitly.

subject: COVER foundational equivalence
finding: SemRisk Risk/Assessment/Likelihood semantics are not proven equivalent to COVER constructs.
claim_consequence: No equivalence/import claims; #25 must resolve affected mappings.

subject: ROSE Control Mechanism mapping
finding: ROSE SecurityMechanism is narrower security profile; SemRisk Control Mechanism is cross-domain.
claim_consequence: No equivalence or novelty-by-renaming; profile alignment only until #25.

subject: CM-PharmE license
finding: Semantic owner/version frozen; redistribution/import license unresolved.
claim_consequence: Federation/mapping allowed conceptually; no redistribution/import assumption.

subject: Comparator missing documentation
finding: Several historical/applied comparators lack complete public artifact/evaluation detail.
claim_consequence: Use `not_reported/unknown`; never count as absent feature.

subject: SemRisk standards conformance
finding: Crosswalk/alignment is not certification or formal conformance testing.
claim_consequence: Manuscript must say aligned/mapped, not ISO/ICH/NIST compliant/certified.

subject: SemRisk differentiator maturity
finding: Main operational semantic chain is conceptually implemented in W2 but not yet formally/evaluatively demonstrated.
